summary: This PR refactors color definitions across numerous SCSS files to improve dark theme support by deriving shades from the secondary (background) color instead of the primary (text) color.
thought_process: The user wants a review of a large SCSS refactoring for dark theme support. The core change replaces `scale-color($primary, $lightness: X%)` with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: X%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: Y%))`. The logic is that for dark themes, colors should be scaled from the background color (`$secondary`) instead of the foreground color (`$primary`). The lightness value for the dark theme (`Y%`) should generally be `100% - X%` to achieve a similar visual effect. I will manually verify this pattern across all 32 changed files. A large, repetitive manual change like this is prone to copy-paste errors. My goal is to find inconsistencies where the light theme's original lightness value is accidentally changed, or the dark theme's lightness value is not correctly inverted. I've identified several such instances. For example, in `desktop/topic-post.scss`, `lightness: 30%` was changed to `lightness: 70%` for the light theme, and the dark theme value was also incorrect. I found similar errors in `desktop/user.scss`, `mobile/modal.scss`, `mobile/topic-post.scss`, and `mobile/user.scss`. These bugs will result in incorrect colors, potentially impacting readability, hence the medium risk level.

comments.comment: This change appears to have incorrect lightness values. The original `lightness: 30%` for the light theme was changed to `70%`, which will make the text much lighter and possibly hard to read. Additionally, the dark theme value should be the inverse of the original, which is `70%`, not `30%`. It looks like the values were swapped. The line should be `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));`.

The lightness value for the light theme has been unintentionally changed from `30%` to `50%`. This will alter the color for light theme users, making it significantly lighter. To fix this while applying the dark theme improvement, this line should be `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));`.

There appears to be a copy-paste error here, as the lightness values for light and dark themes are swapped. The light theme color is changed from `70%` lightness to `30%`, and the dark theme gets `70%` instead of the correctly inverted `30%`. The desktop version of this file (`desktop/modal.scss`) has the correct values. This should be `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));`.

The lightness value for the light theme has been unintentionally changed from `20%` to `50%`, which will make the `h3` element significantly lighter. The desktop version of this style is correct. This should be `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%));`.

The lightness value for the light theme has been unintentionally changed from `30%` to `50%`. This is the same issue as in the desktop version of this file. To fix this, the line should be `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));`.
